title: StaticData
description: Schema for *.data.json artifacts (kind: static_data). A flat list of options an agency-side generic_template's JSONForms enum/oneOf can be populated from at runtime, e.g. tnsw/npqs/1-apply/importing_countries.data.json.

items.description: One option. A field's x-search.displayTemplate fills {const}, {title} and {key} for any other key of the row. {id} and {name} are legacy names for const and title, kept for deployed forms. Other keys can be named in x-search.params.searchKeys, so a typed search matches them. Content under an existing (id, version) cannot change, so rows with new keys ship as a new version.

additionalProperties.description: An extra key a template or a search can use. Its name uses letters, digits and underscores, as a template placeholder does, and is not id or name, which the trader-app sets from const and title. Its value is a string, number or boolean, the values a template prints and a search matches.

const.description: Value stored when this option is selected, e.g. a country code or commodity name.

title.description: Human-readable label shown for this option.

parents.description: When x-search.dependsOn is set, this option is offered only if the sibling field's value is in this list.
